record.paper_title: Invitation to H-systems in higher dimensions: known results, new facts, and related open problems
record.original_question: Let n > 2, let B^n be the unit ball in R^n, let H: R^{n+1} -> R be bounded and Lipschitz, and let u=(u^1,...,u^{n+1}) be in W^{1,n}(B^n,R^{n+1}). Define J_u as partial_{x_1}u cross ... cross partial_{x_n}u, the vector in R^{n+1} whose coordinates are the n by n minors of Du. If u is a weak solution of the H-system -div(|grad u|^{n-2} grad u) = H(u) J_u, must u be continuous on B^n?

evidence.quote: Set Ju = ∂u/∂x1 × · · · × ∂u/∂xn; for x ∈ B n this is a vector in Rn+1 with coordinates given by the n × n minors of the Jacobi matrix of Du.
Problem 2.4. Let n > 2. Suppose that H : Rn+1 → R is bounded and Lipschitz. Are all weak solutions u ∈ W 1,n (B n , Rn+1 ) of (2.5) continuous?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n>2$ and let $B^n\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ denote the open unit ball. Let $H:\mathbb{R}^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a bounded Lipschitz function. For a map $u=(u^1,\dots,u^{n+1})\in W^{1,n}(B^n,\mathbb{R}^{n+1})$, define
$$J_u(x) \;=\; \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1}(x)\times\cdots\times \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_n}(x),$$
i.e. the vector in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ whose $k$-th coordinate is $(-1)^{k+1}$ times the determinant of the $n\times n$ minor of $Du$ obtained by deleting the $k$-th row. Consider the H-system
$$-\operatorname{div}\!\bigl(|\nabla u|^{n-2}\,\nabla u\bigr) \;=\; H(u)\,J_u \qquad \text{in } B^n,$$
understood in the weak sense (every component equation tested against $W^{1,n}_0\cap L^\infty$ test functions).

Question: Must every weak solution $u\in W^{1,n}(B^n,\mathbb{R}^{n+1})$ of this system be continuous on $B^n$?
artifact.status_search_result: Continuity/regularity of weak $W^{1,n}$ solutions of the higher-dimensional H-system with bounded Lipschitz $H$ for general $n>2$ appears to remain open. Partial results exist under stronger regularity assumptions (e.g. solutions in $W^{n/2,2}$ for even $n$ are known to be locally Hölder continuous), but the question as stated under only $W^{1,n}$ regularity has not been resolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Regularity for solutions of H-systems and n-harmonic maps with n/2 square integrable derivatives
status_evidence.snippet: Regularity is established for weak solutions of H-systems in W^{n/2,2}, with H bounded Lipschitz, for even n.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results in stronger function spaces are known; the W^{1,n} case remains a recognized open problem.

status_evidence.title: Invitation to H-systems in higher dimensions (arXiv:1606.07891)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of known results, new facts and related open problems for higher-dimensional H-systems.
status_evidence.claim: The continuity question for W^{1,n} weak solutions is listed among the open problems in this area.
